records.title: Ancient Ruins
records.description: The ancient ruins (古遺跡, Furui Iseki), also known as giant ruins (巨大な古遺, Kyodai na Furui Iseki), are recurring structures found throughout the Lands Between in Elden Ring. They were seemingly built by the ancient civilization associated with the ruins at Rauh (ラウフ, Raufu, possibly [https://en.m.wiktionary.org/wiki/lauf#Old_Norse Lauf]).

records.title: Corpse
records.description: Corpses are stationary objects that can be looted for Items. Like Stranded Souls, they are often positioned to convey environmental storytelling. Many lie in the immediate vicinity of events related to the items they carry, while others are posed facing a relevant landmark, NPC, or other point of interest. Corpses vary in their model, pose, and equipped weapon.
